{"credits": [], "cve_id": null, "cvss": {"score": null, "vector_string": null}, "cvss_severities": {"cvss_v3": {"score": 0.0, "vector_string": null}, "cvss_v4": {"score": 8.2, "vector_string": "CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N"}}, "cwes": [{"cwe_id": "CWE-522", "name": "Insufficiently Protected Credentials"}], "description": "## Summary

A rogue MySQL server (or MITM) can force mysql2 to send credentials in **plaintext** by requesting an auth switch to `mysql_clear_password`. The driver complies without verifying that TLS is active.

## Details

`mysql_clear_password` is registered as a default standard plugin in `lib/commands/auth_switch.js` (line 21). When a server sends an AuthSwitchRequest (0xFE) requesting `mysql_clear_password`, the driver executes it without checking for TLS. The plugin (`lib/auth_plugins/mysql_clear_password.js`) returns `Buffer.from(password + '\0')`.

Note: `caching_sha2_password` plugin DOES check for SSL before sending cleartext (line 77). But `mysql_clear_password` has no such guard.

## Attack Scenario

1. Attacker operates rogue MySQL server or performs MITM
2. Server advertises `caching_sha2_password` in handshake
3. Client sends hashed auth response
4. Server replies with AuthSwitchRequest to `mysql_clear_password`
5. Client sends password in plaintext
6. Attacker captures plaintext password

## PoC

Rogue MySQL server (Node.js, ~80 lines) that captures plaintext passwords from mysql2 clients. Tested against mysql2 3.20.0. Full PoC available on request.

## Suggested Fix

Remove `mysql_clear_password` from `standardAuthPlugins`, or add a guard requiring TLS/unix socket before allowing cleartext auth.

## Impact

- mysql2: 9M weekly downloads
- Any application connecting without TLS is vulnerable to credential theft
- Cloud environments with untrusted network paths are especially at risk", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-09-01T16:40:34Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-09-01T16:40:34Z", "references": ["https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/security/advisories/GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr", "https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/issues/1617", "https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/pull/4236", "https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/commit/884bec56288d827939d0dd3f1f4ae476fbc8dbeb", "https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/releases/tag/v3.22.0", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/sidorares/node-mysql2/security-advisories/GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr", "severity": "high", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2", "summary": "MySQL2: Auth Plugin Downgrade to mysql_clear_password Leaks Plaintext Credentials", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-09-01T16:40:35Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "3.22.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "mysql2"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 3.22.0"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
